blocks.value: Volume tells us how many shares were traded during a specific period. It helps us understand how active a stock is.

Imagine This: Two vegetable markets both sell tomatoes. One sells 20 bags in a day, while the other sells 2,000 bags. The second market clearly has much more activity. Volume works exactly the same way in the stock market.
High volume usually means many buyers and sellers are actively trading the stock. Low volume means fewer people are participating.
If Reliance trades 2 crore shares today, its trading volume for the day is 2 crore shares.
Volume tells you how much interest there is in a stock. Price tells you where it is trading.

blocks.question: High trading volume usually indicates...
choices: Many buyers and sellers are active.
